description: Thunder Hill Elementary School families are invited to participate in Fall Parent-Teacher Conferences to discuss student progress and learning. Conference Schedule: * Monday, November 23: In-person…
description_full: Thunder Hill Elementary School families are invited to participate in Fall Parent-Teacher Conferences to discuss student progress and learning. Conference Schedule: * Monday, November 23: In-person conferences only. * Tuesday, November 24 & Wednesday, November 25: Virtual conferences only. Important Information: * Fall conferences will focus on English Language Arts (ELA). * Math conferences with Ms. Parson (4th Grade Advanced Academic Program) and Ms. Kozikowski (2nd Grade Math Differentiated) will also be available. * Additional math conferences will take place in February. * Related Arts teachers will offer limited conference appointments and designated office hours. How to Schedule: 1. Visit https://www.hcpss.org/connect/ 2. Select “Conference” from the left-hand menu. 3. Choose “Parent Scheduled Conferences.” 4. Select an available time slot. Conference scheduling is now open through HCPSS Connect. Families needing assistance with scheduling should contact the THES front office.
